setup: CREATE TEMP TABLE samples(g INTEGER,n INTEGER); INSERT INTO samples VALUES(1,1),(1,2),(2,3); CREATE FUNCTION pg_temp.aggregate_transition(bigint,integer) RETURNS bigint LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE AS 'SELECT $1 + COALESCE($2,0)'; CREATE AGGREGATE pg_temp.host_sum(integer)(SFUNC=pg_temp.aggregate_transition,STYPE=bigint,INITCOND='0');

cases.name: global
cases.query: SELECT pg_temp.host_sum(n) AS v FROM samples

cases.name: empty_global
cases.query: SELECT pg_temp.host_sum(n) AS v FROM samples WHERE false

cases.name: empty_grouped
cases.query: SELECT pg_temp.host_sum(n) AS v FROM samples WHERE false GROUP BY g

cases.name: grouped
cases.query: SELECT pg_temp.host_sum(n) AS v FROM samples GROUP BY g ORDER BY g

cases.name: grouping_sets
cases.query: SELECT pg_temp.host_sum(n) AS v FROM samples GROUP BY GROUPING SETS((),(g),()) ORDER BY v

cases.name: ordered
cases.query: SELECT pg_temp.host_sum(n ORDER BY n DESC) AS v FROM samples

cases.name: distinct
cases.query: SELECT pg_temp.host_sum(DISTINCT g) AS v FROM samples

cases.name: filtered
cases.query: SELECT pg_temp.host_sum(n) FILTER(WHERE false) AS v FROM samples

cases.name: having
cases.query: SELECT pg_temp.host_sum(n) AS v FROM samples HAVING pg_temp.host_sum(n) < 0

cases.name: empty_window
cases.query: SELECT pg_temp.host_sum(n) OVER() AS v FROM samples WHERE false

cases.name: cumulative_window
cases.query: SELECT pg_temp.host_sum(n) OVER(ORDER BY n ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS v FROM samples ORDER BY n

cases.name: partition_window
cases.query: SELECT pg_temp.host_sum(n) OVER(PARTITION BY g ORDER BY n ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS v FROM samples ORDER BY n

cases.name: moving_window
cases.query: SELECT pg_temp.host_sum(n) OVER(ORDER BY n ROWS CURRENT ROW) AS v FROM samples ORDER BY n

cases.name: empty_frame
cases.query: SELECT pg_temp.host_sum(n) OVER(ORDER BY n ROWS BETWEEN 1 FOLLOWING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS v FROM samples WHERE n=1

cases.name: exclusion_window
cases.query: SELECT pg_temp.host_sum(n) OVER(ORDER BY n ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW EXCLUDE CURRENT ROW) AS v FROM samples ORDER BY n

cases.name: input_error
cases.query: SELECT pg_temp.host_sum(10/(n-2)) AS v FROM samples

cases.name: grouped_input_error
cases.query: SELECT pg_temp.host_sum(10/(n-2)) AS v FROM samples GROUP BY g
